enforcement_authorities: National Development and Reform Commission (国家发展改革委)
Provincial, autonomous region, and municipal people's governments (各省、自治区、直辖市人民政府)
State Council ministries, commissions, and directly affiliated institutions (国务院各部委、各直属机构)
implementation_notes: National strategic action plan (Guofa [2025] No. 11) coordinated by the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) for localized implementation by ministries and sub-national governments. Establishes phased national adoption milestones rather than binding legal compliance deadlines: >70% adoption of new-generation smart terminals and AI agents across six priority domains by 2027, >90% adoption by 2030, and full transition to an intelligent economy and society by 2035. Calls for advancing AI legislation, optimizing security assessment and filing management systems, and establishing an inclusive, prudent, tiered/classified (分类分级) governance framework.
